metas.name: Resident Evil
metas.description: Follows a hapless courier tasked with delivering a package to a remote hospital. He soon finds himself caught in the middle of an outbreak and must fight through hordes of mutated creatures to survive.

metas.name: Avengers: Endgame
metas.description: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War (2018), the universe is in ruins. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers assemble once more in order to reverse Thanos' actions and restore balance to the universe.

metas.name: Project Hail Mary
metas.description: A science teacher wakes up alone on a spaceship. As his memory returns, he uncovers a mission to stop a mysterious substance killing Earth's sun, and realizes that an unexpected friendship may be the key.

metas.name: Backrooms
metas.description: Clark, an angry architect, chases the source of impossible power failures when a glowing gap opens in his basement, but the yellow maze beyond it threatens his sanity, his friends, and Mary.

metas.name: The Hunger Games
metas.description: Katniss Everdeen voluntarily takes her younger sister's place in the Hunger Games: a televised competition in which two teenagers from each of the twelve Districts of Panem are chosen at random to fight to the death.

metas.name: Disclosure Day
metas.description: If you found out we weren't alone, if someone showed you, proved it to you, would that frighten you?

metas.name: The Dog Stars
metas.description: In a post-apocalyptic world, a virus wipes out humanity. Survivors face roaming scavengers called Reapers. Protagonist Hig, a pilot, survived the flu but lost his wife.

metas.name: The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes
metas.description: Coriolanus Snow mentors and develops feelings for the female District 12 tribute during the 10th Hunger Games.

metas.name: Interstellar
metas.description: In a dystopian future where Earth has become near-uninhabitable, a team of astronauts embark on a mission to find a new home for humanity.

metas.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
metas.description: A meek Hobbit from the Shire and eight companions set out on a journey to destroy the powerful One Ring and save Middle-earth from the Dark Lord Sauron.

metas.name: Inception
metas.description: A thief who steals corporate secrets through the use of dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a CEO, but his tragic past may doom the project and his team to disaster.

metas.name: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
metas.description: An orphaned boy enrolls in a school of wizardry, where he learns the truth about himself, his family and the terrible evil that haunts the magical world.

metas.name: The Prestige
metas.description: Two magicians dismantle their lives to outmaneuver each other following a shared tragedy. They chase the ultimate illusion across Victorian London, sacrificing sanity and safety to master a teleportation feat that defies all logic.

metas.name: Dracula
metas.description: When a 15th-century prince denounces God after the loss of his wife he inherits an eternal curse: he becomes Dracula. Condemned to wander the centuries, he defies fate and death, guided by a single hope - to be reunited with his l...

metas.name: Frankenstein
metas.description: Dr. Victor Frankenstein, a brilliant but egotistical scientist, brings a creature to life in a monstrous experiment that ultimately leads to the undoing of both the creator and his tragic creation.

metas.name: Masters of the Universe
metas.description: Prince Adam discovers that the strange memories shaping his life are real when the lost Sword of Power resurfaces, forcing him to return to Eternia and challenge the tyrant who shattered his family and kingdom.

metas.name: V for Vendetta
metas.description: A young woman living in a dystopian society meets a shadowy freedom fighter who is plotting to overthrow their tyrannical government.

metas.name: Practical Magic 2
metas.description: A multi generational family of witches, cursed to be loveless for centuries, attempts to break the spell by confronting dark secrets and sacrificing for each other.

metas.name: Nosferatu
metas.description: A gothic tale of obsession between a haunted young woman and the terrifying vampire infatuated with her, causing untold horror in its wake.

metas.name: The Day After Tomorrow
metas.description: When a sudden international storm plunges the planet into a new Ice Age, a paleoclimatologist must make a daring trek to reach his son.

metas.name: Bugonia
metas.description: Two conspiracy-obsessed young men kidnap the high-powered CEO of a major company, convinced that she is an alien intent on destroying planet Earth.

metas.name: Superman
metas.description: Superman must reconcile his alien Kryptonian heritage with his human upbringing as reporter Clark Kent. As the embodiment of truth, justice and the American way he soon finds himself in a world that views these as old-fashioned.

metas.name: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 1
metas.description: Katniss Everdeen is in District 13 after she shatters the games forever. Under the leadership of President Coin and the advice of her trusted friends, Katniss spreads her wings as she fights to save Peeta and a nation moved by her...

metas.name: Leviticus
metas.description: Two teenage boys must escape a violent entity that takes the form of the person they desire most - each other.

metas.name: The Matrix
metas.description: A computer hacker discovers that his life is nothing more than an elaborate simulation run by an evil AI.

metas.name: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
metas.description: Forced to balance their roles as heroes with the strength of their family bond, the Fantastic Four must defend Earth from a ravenous space god called Galactus and his enigmatic herald, the Silver Surfer.

metas.name: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
metas.description: As Spike is inducted into Jimmy Crystal's gang on the mainland, Dr. Kelson makes a discovery that could alter the world.

metas.name: Addams Family Values
metas.description: The Addams Family try to rescue their beloved Uncle Fester from his gold-digging new love, a black widow named Debbie.

metas.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
metas.description: Gandalf and Aragorn lead the World of Men against Sauron's army to draw his gaze from Frodo and Sam as they approach Mount Doom with the One Ring.

metas.name: Apocalypse Z: The Beginning of the End
metas.description: Manel is sheltering from a rabies-like disease which sweeps the planet, until he is forced to leave and meet unlikely but essential traveling companions.

metas.name: Avengers: Infinity War
metas.description: The Avengers and their allies must be willing to sacrifice all in an attempt to defeat the powerful Thanos before his blitz of devastation and ruin puts an end to the universe.

metas.name: Resident Evil
metas.description: A special military unit fights a powerful, out-of-control supercomputer and hundreds of scientists who have mutated into flesh-eating creatures after a laboratory accident.

metas.name: How the Grinch Stole Christmas
metas.description: On the outskirts of Whoville lives a green, revenge-seeking Grinch who plans to ruin Christmas for all of the citizens of the town.

metas.name: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
metas.description: An intrepid blacksmith teams up with an eccentric pirate captain to save his love from an undead pirate crew.

metas.name: Practical Magic
metas.description: Two witch sisters, raised by their eccentric aunts in a small town, face closed-minded prejudice and a curse which threatens to prevent them ever finding lasting love.

metas.name: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 2
metas.description: Katniss and a team of rebels from District 13 prepare for the final battle that will decide the fate of Panem.

metas.name: The Thing
metas.description: A research team in Antarctica is hunted by a shape-shifting alien that assumes the appearance of its victims.

metas.name: Spider-Man: No Way Home
metas.description: Peter Parker turns to Doctor Strange after his identity destroys the life he knows, but a magical mistake draws powerful outsiders into his world and forces him to confront what being Spider Man really means.

metas.name: X-Men
metas.description: In a world where mutants (evolved super-powered humans) exist and are discriminated against, two groups form for an inevitable clash: the supremacist Brotherhood, and the pacifist X-Men.

metas.name: Mickey 17
metas.description: During a human expedition to colonize space, Mickey 17, a so-called "expendable" employee, is sent to explore an ice planet.

metas.name: The Green Mile
metas.description: A death row guard learns that a gentle giant in his charge possesses a mysterious gift.

metas.name: Back to the Future
metas.description: Marty McFly, a 17-year-old high school student, is accidentally sent 30 years into the past in a time-traveling DeLorean invented by his close friend, the maverick scientist Doc Brown.

metas.name: War Machine
metas.description: Follow the final recruits of a grueling special ops boot camp who encounter a mysterious deadly force.

metas.name: The Avengers
metas.description: Earth's mightiest heroes must come together and learn to fight as a team if they are going to stop the mischievous Loki and his alien army from enslaving humanity.

metas.name: Tenet
metas.description: Armed with only the word "Tenet," and fighting for the survival of the entire world, CIA operative, The Protagonist, journeys through a twilight world of international espionage on a global mission that unfolds beyond real time.

metas.name: Arrival
metas.description: Linguist Louise Banks leads a team of investigators when gigantic spaceships touch down around the world. As nations teeter on the verge of global war, Banks and her crew must find a way to communicate with the extraterrestrial vi...

metas.name: Van Helsing
metas.description: The famed monster hunter is sent to Transylvania to stop Count Dracula, who is using Dr. Frankenstein's research and a werewolf for nefarious purposes.

metas.name: Sunshine
metas.description: A team of international astronauts is sent on a dangerous mission to reignite the dying Sun with a nuclear fission bomb in 2057.

metas.name: Ghostbusters II
metas.description: The discovery of a massive river of ectoplasm and a resurgence of spectral activity allows the staff of Ghostbusters to revive the business.

metas.name: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
metas.description: Harry Potter finds himself competing in a hazardous tournament between rival schools of magic, but he is distracted by recurring nightmares.

metas.name: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
metas.description: When their relationship turns sour, a couple undergoes a medical procedure to have each other erased from their memories forever.

metas.name: It's a Wonderful Life
metas.description: An angel is sent from Heaven to help a desperately frustrated businessman see the value of his own life.

metas.name: Alien
metas.description: After investigating a mysterious transmission of unknown origin, the crew of a commercial spacecraft encounters a deadly lifeform.

metas.name: Companion
metas.description: A weekend getaway with friends at a remote cabin turns into chaos after it's revealed that one of the guests is not what they seem.

metas.name: Godzilla
metas.description: Following the 1999 Janjira nuclear disaster that claimed his wife Sandra, Joe Brody seeks answers. His Navy officer son Ford accompanies him to Japan, where they discover the devastating truth and see ancient monsters emerge.

metas.name: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
metas.description: A cyborg from the future, identical to the one who failed to kill Sarah Connor, must now protect her ten-year-old son John from an even more advanced and powerful cyborg.

metas.name: Spider-Man
metas.description: A shy teenager is bitten by a genetically modified spider and uses his new spider-like abilities to fight injustice as a masked superhero.

metas.name: Avengers: Age of Ultron
metas.description: When Tony Stark and Bruce Banner try to jump-start a dormant peacekeeping program called Ultron, things go horribly wrong and it's up to Earth's mightiest heroes to stop the villainous Ultron from enacting his terrible plan.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: At an archaeological dig in the ancient city of Hamunaptra, an American serving in the French Foreign Legion accidentally awakens a mummy who begins to wreak havoc as he searches for the reincarnation of his long-lost love.

metas.name: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
metas.description: Doctor Strange teams up with a mysterious teenage girl who can travel across multiverses, to battle other-universe versions of himself which threaten to wipe out the multiverse. They seek help from the Scarlet Witch, Wong and others.

metas.name: Doctor Sleep
metas.description: Years following the events of The Shining (1980), a now-adult Dan Torrance must protect a young girl with similar powers from a cult known as The True Knot, who prey on children with powers to remain immortal.

metas.name: The Terminator
metas.description: A cyborg assassin from the future attempts to find and kill a young woman who is destined to give birth to a warrior that will lead a resistance to save humankind from extinction.

metas.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
metas.description: While Frodo and Sam edge closer to Mordor with the help of the shifty Gollum, the divided fellowship makes a stand against Sauron's new ally, Saruman, and his hordes of Isengard.

metas.name: Ghostbusters
metas.description: Armed with proton packs, four paranormal investigators battle mischievous ghouls in New York.

metas.name: Iron Man
metas.description: After being held captive in an Afghan cave, billionaire engineer Tony Stark creates a unique weaponized suit of armor to fight evil.

metas.name: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
metas.description: Harry Potter lives his second year at Hogwarts with Ron and Hermione when a message on the wall announces that the legendary Chamber of Secrets has been opened. The trio soon realize that, to save the school, it will take a lot of...

metas.name: Mortal Kombat II
metas.description: The fan favorite champions -- now joined by Johnny Cage himself -- are pitted against one another in the ultimate battle to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn that threatens the very existence of the Earthrealm and its defenders.

metas.name: Idiocracy
metas.description: Corporal Joe Bauers, a decidedly average American, is selected for a top-secret hibernation program but is forgotten and left to awaken to a future so incredibly moronic that he's easily the most intelligent person alive.

metas.name: Independence Day
metas.description: The aliens are coming and their goal is to invade and destroy Earth. Fighting superior technology, mankind's best weapon is the will to survive.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Homecoming
metas.description: Peter Parker tries to stop Adrian 'The Vulture' Toomes from selling weapons made with advanced Chitauri technology while trying to balance his life as an ordinary high school student.

metas.name: A Clockwork Orange
metas.description: Alex DeLarge and his droogs barbarize a decaying near-future.

metas.name: Wicked
metas.description: Elphaba, a young woman ridiculed for her green skin, and Galinda, a popular girl, become friends at Shiz University in the Land of Oz. After an encounter with the Wonderful Wizard of Oz, their friendship reaches a crossroads.

metas.name: Jurassic Park
metas.description: An industrialist invites some experts to visit his theme park of cloned dinosaurs. After a power failure, the creatures run loose, putting everyone's lives, including his grandchildren's, in danger.

metas.name: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
metas.description: Harry Potter, Ron and Hermione return to Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry for their third year of study, where they delve into the mystery surrounding an escaped prisoner who poses a dangerous threat to the young wizard.

metas.name: The Running Man
metas.description: A man joins a game show in which contestants, allowed to flee anywhere in the world, are pursued by "hunters" hired to kill them.

metas.name: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
metas.description: Four siblings wind up entering the magical land of Narnia. Once there, they discover a world inhabited by fantastical creatures and find themselves in a battle to defeat a witch.

metas.name: The Fly
metas.description: A botched experiment transmutes a man into a monstrous insect.

metas.name: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2
metas.description: Harry, Ron and Hermione set out on a quest to eliminate the remaining horcruxes. On the other hand, the students and teachers must unite to defend Hogwarts against Lord Voldemort and his army.

metas.name: About Time
metas.description: At the age of 21, Tim discovers he can travel in time and change what happens and has happened in his own life. His decision to make his world a better place by getting a girlfriend turns out not to be as easy as you might think.

metas.name: Predator: Badlands
metas.description: A young Predator outcast from his clan finds an unlikely ally on his journey in search of the ultimate adversary.

metas.name: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
metas.description: Shang-Chi, the master of weaponry-based Kung Fu, is forced to confront his past after being drawn into the Ten Rings organization.

metas.name: Donnie Darko
metas.description: After narrowly escaping a bizarre accident, a troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a man in a large rabbit suit who manipulates him to commit a series of crimes.

metas.name: The Witch
metas.description: An isolated Puritan family in 1630s New England comes unraveled by the forces of witchcraft and possession.

metas.name: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
metas.description: With their warning about Lord Voldemort's return scoffed at, Harry and Dumbledore are targeted by the Wizard authorities as an authoritarian bureaucrat slowly seizes power at Hogwarts.

metas.name: Pet Sematary
metas.description: After tragedy strikes, a grieving father discovers an ancient burial ground behind his home with the power to raise the dead.

metas.name: Mad Max: Fury Road
metas.description: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a woman rebels against a tyrannical ruler in search for her homeland with the aid of a group of female prisoners, a psychotic worshipper and a drifter named Max.

metas.name: Captain America: The First Avenger
metas.description: Steve Rogers, a rejected military soldier, transforms into Captain America after taking a dose of a "Super-Soldier serum". But being Captain America comes at a price as he attempts to take down a warmonger and a terrorist organiza...

metas.name: 28 Years Later
metas.description: A group of survivors of the rage virus live on a small island. When one of the group leaves the island on a mission into the mainland, he discovers secrets, wonders, and horrors that have mutated not only the infected but other su...

metas.name: A Nightmare on Elm Street 3: Dream Warriors
metas.description: A psychiatrist, familiar with the knife-wielding dream demon Freddy Krueger, helps teens at a mental hospital battle the killer who is invading their dreams.

metas.name: Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope
metas.description: A farmboy joins forces with various allies to save their galaxy from the evil Empire's planet-destroying battle station, while also rescuing the princess leading the rebellion against them.

metas.name: Aliens
metas.description: Decades after surviving the Nostromo incident, Ellen Ripley is sent out to re-establish contact with a terraforming colony but finds herself battling the Alien Queen and her offspring.

metas.name: The Faculty
metas.description: Six misfit students must band together to save mankind when mind-controlling parasites from another planet infect their high school's faculty.

metas.name: Beetlejuice
metas.description: The spirits of a deceased couple are harassed by an unbearable family that has moved into their home, and hire a malicious spirit to drive them out.

metas.name: The Martian
metas.description: An astronaut stranded on Mars must rely on his ingenuity to survive and arrange a potential rescue.

metas.name: Ready Player One
metas.description: When the creator of a virtual reality called the OASIS dies, he makes a posthumous challenge to all OASIS users to find his Easter Egg, which will give the finder his fortune and control of his world.

metas.name: Blade Runner
metas.description: A blade runner must pursue and terminate four replicants who stole a ship in space and have returned to Earth to find their creator.

metas.name: 2001: A Space Odyssey
metas.description: When a mysterious artifact is uncovered on the Moon, a spacecraft manned by two scientists and one supercomputer is dispatched to Jupiter to find its origins.

metas.name: X2: X-Men United
metas.description: When anti-mutant Colonel William Stryker kidnaps Professor X and attacks his school, the X-Men must ally with their archenemy Magneto to stop him.

metas.name: What Women Want
metas.description: A cocky, chauvinistic advertising executive magically acquires the ability to hear what women are thinking.

metas.name: The Man from Earth
metas.description: A professor's impromptu retirement party becomes a mysterious interrogation when he reveals to his colleagues that he has a longer and stranger past than they can imagine.
